ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var ext = vars.fileExtension var source = if (ext == "xlsx") read(payload, "application/xlsx") else if (ext == "xml") read(payload, "application/xml") else error("Unsupported input file: " ++ ext) var customers = if (ext == "xlsx") source.Customers else source.CustomerOrders.Customers.Customer var orders = if (ext == "xlsx") source.Orders else source.CustomerOrders.Orders.Order --- { customers: customers map (c) -> { customerId: c.customerId as String, firstName: c.firstName as String, lastName: c.lastName as String, email: c.email as String, phone: (c.phone default "") as String, city: (c.city default "") as String }, orders: orders map (o) -> { orderId: o.orderId as String, customerId: o.customerId as String, orderDate: o.orderDate as String, status: o.status as String, totalAmount: o.totalAmount as Number } }

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Upsert customers
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, city) VALUES (:customerId, :firstName, :lastName, :email, :phone, :city) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE first_name=VALUES(first_name), last_name=VALUES(last_name), email=VALUES(email), phone=VALUES(phone), city=VALUES(city)

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Upsert orders
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, customer_id, order_date, status, total_amount) VALUES (:orderId, :customerId, :orderDate, :status, :totalAmount) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE customer_id=VALUES(customer_id), order_date=VALUES(order_date), status=VALUES(status), total_amount=VALUES(total_amount)

set-payload.value: #[write({status:'FAILED', sourceFile:vars.sourceFileName, failedAt:now(), errorType:error.errorType as String, description:error.description}, 'application/json', {indent:true})]
